# telemetry API

Current state, history, positions, maps, health and reports.

Base path `/api/v1/telemetry` behind the gateway. Authentication, rate limits and the error format are the same for every service: see [Scripting MowDeck](../../guides/scripting.md). Rendered from [`apps/web/openapi/telemetry.json`](https://github.com/lukislp/mowdeck/blob/main/apps/web/openapi/telemetry.json) (OpenAPI 3.1), which you can also load into any OpenAPI tool.

## Operations

### telemetry

#### GET /api/v1/telemetry/accounts/me/mowers/capabilities

**List Capabilities**

Capabilities of every mower of the caller's account that the caller may view and whose gateway has reported them (same bound as the states list).

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [MowerCapabilitiesList](#mowercapabilitieslist) |

#### GET /api/v1/telemetry/accounts/me/mowers/states

**List States**

Latest state of every mower of the caller's account that the caller may view.

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [MowerStateList](#mowerstatelist) |

#### GET /api/v1/telemetry/mowers/{mower_id}/aerial

**Get Aerial**

Whether an aerial photo can be laid under the mower's map, with its credit line, zoom range and the box where tiles are served; `enabled: false` without a configured source. 404 `no-map-yet` before the gateway published a map.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mower_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [AerialOut](#aerialout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### GET /api/v1/telemetry/mowers/{mower_id}/aerial/{z}/{x}/{y}

**Get Aerial Tile**

One aerial photo tile (Web Mercator, XYZ) around the mower's map. Tiles away from the map or outside the zoom range are 404 `tile-outside-map`, so this is no open proxy; new tiles are rate limited per account (429).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mower_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `z` | path | integer | yes | min 0; max 24 |
| `x` | path | integer | yes | min 0 |
| `y` | path | integer | yes | min 0 |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `image/jpeg` any, `image/png` any |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### GET /api/v1/telemetry/mowers/{mower_id}/battery

**Get Battery**

Battery percentage over time; with `step` one point per bin (mean, min, max, charging if any). Same ranges and limits as the history.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mower_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `from` | query | string (date-time) or null | no | Start of the range (inclusive). |
| `to` | query | string (date-time) or null | no | End of the range (exclusive). |
| `step` | query | string or null | no | Bin width such as 5s, 1m, 1h or 1d (date_bin); raw rows without. |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [BatterySeries](#batteryseries) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### POST /api/v1/telemetry/mowers/{mower_id}/health/blade-reset

**Reset Blade**

Record a blade change: the blade hours since the change restart at zero and the threshold reminder is armed again. Works before the first telemetry, too.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mower_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

**Request body** (required): `application/json` [BladeResetIn](#bladeresetin)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [MowerHealthOut](#mowerhealthout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### PUT /api/v1/telemetry/mowers/{mower_id}/health/blade-threshold

**Set Blade Threshold**

Set the mower's blade reminder threshold in hours (`can_manage_mowers`, like the blade reset); `null` drops it, so the mower follows its own warning again (`device_blade_warn_hours`) when it reports one, else the default (`MOWDECK_TELEMETRY_BLADE_HOURS_THRESHOLD`); `blade_hours_threshold_effective` names the threshold in effect. The reminder is armed again when the blade hours shown lie below the new effective threshold. Works before the first telemetry, too. The warning stored on the mower itself is not changed.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mower_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

**Request body** (required): `application/json` [BladeThresholdIn](#bladethresholdin)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [MowerHealthOut](#mowerhealthout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### GET /api/v1/telemetry/mowers/{mower_id}/heatmap

**Get Heatmap**

A raster layer over the mower's map frame for a time range (default: the last 7 days): cut share and missed areas (`coverage`), share of fixed RTK samples (`rtk`) or median signal in dBm (`wifi`, `mnet`). 404 `no-map-yet` before the gateway published a map.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mower_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `layer` | query | [Layer](#layer) | yes | coverage, rtk, wifi or mnet. |
| `from` | query | string (date-time) or null | no | Start of the range (inclusive). |
| `to` | query | string (date-time) or null | no | End of the range (exclusive). |
| `cell` | query | `0.5` \| `1` \| `2` | no | Cell size in metres: 0.5, 1 or 2.; default `1.0` |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [MowerHeatmap](#mowerheatmap) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### GET /api/v1/telemetry/mowers/{mower_id}/map

**Get Map**

The mower's map as the Device-Gateway last read it; 404 `no-map-yet` before that.

The ETag is the map revision, so a client can revalidate with `If-None-Match`.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mower_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `if-none-match` | header | string or null | no |  |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [MowerMapOut](#mowermapout) |
| 304 | Not modified (`If-None-Match` equals the ETag) | no body |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### GET /api/v1/telemetry/mowers/{mower_id}/path

**Get Mow Path**

The route the mower planned for its running job (local metres of its map) with the progress along it, as the Device-Gateway last published it; 404 `no-path` without a job or before the route arrived. Clients poll it while the mower works.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mower_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [MowPathOut](#mowpathout) |
| 404 | `no-path`: no running job whose route is known. | no body |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### GET /api/v1/telemetry/mowers/{mower_id}/widget

**Get Widget State**

A compact state for the iOS widgets and the Live Activity (ADR 0059): activity (`offline` when stale), battery, rain sensor, error and the job with progress, area name and remaining time. 404 "no telemetry yet" before the first state.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mower_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [WidgetStateOut](#widgetstateout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### GET /api/v1/telemetry/mowers/{mower_id}/widget-map.png

**Get Widget Map**

A PNG of the mower's map for the iOS map widget (ADR 0059): areas, no-go zones, the mowed path (the mow path up to its progress, else the last 3 hours of the track), the dock and the mower. Bounded in size, cached for 30 seconds and drawn at most twice at a time. 404 `no-map-yet` before the gateway published a map.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mower_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `width` | query | integer | no | Pixels (clamped to 700k in all).; min 160; max 1200; default `640` |
| `height` | query | integer | no | min 96; max 800; default `384` |
| `theme` | query | string | no | pattern `^(light|dark)$`; default `"light"` |
| `if-none-match` | header | string or null | no |  |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | The map picture. | `image/png` any |
| 304 | Not modified (`If-None-Match` equals the ETag) | no body |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |
| 503 | All drawing slots are taken; retry in a few seconds. | no body |

#### GET /api/v1/telemetry/reports/summary

**Get Report Summary**

Day totals (UTC days, default the last 30, at most 366) of every mower of the caller's account that the caller may view, in one call: blade and mowing hours, distance, jobs, online hours, battery cycles, charge sessions and errors by code. Mowers without data in the range are absent; Telemetry does not know sites, so clients filter by Fleet's `site_id` (or pass `mower_id`).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `from` | query | string (date) or null | no | First UTC day (inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD). |
| `to` | query | string (date) or null | no | Last UTC day (inclusive). |
| `mower_id` | query | array of string (uuid) or null | no | Only these mowers (repeatable); invisible ones are left out silently. |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [ReportSummary](#reportsummary) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

## Schemas

### AerialBounds

A box in WGS84 degrees.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `east` | number | yes |  |
| `north` | number | yes |  |
| `south` | number | yes |  |
| `west` | number | yes |  |

### AerialOut

The aerial photo under a mower's map.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `attribution` | string or null | yes | Credit line to show while the photo is on. |
| `bounds` | [AerialBounds](#aerialbounds) or null | yes | Where tiles are served: the map's outline plus a margin. |
| `enabled` | boolean | yes | False when the installation has no aerial photo source. |
| `max_zoom` | integer or null | yes | Highest zoom with real detail; scale beyond it. |
| `min_zoom` | integer or null | yes |  |
| `mower_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `tile_url` | string or null | yes | URL template of the tiles (`{z}`, `{x}`, `{y}`); needs the bearer token. |

### BaseStationPosition

Where the base station stands (WGS84 degrees), as the mower knows it.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `lat` | number | yes | min -90.0; max 90.0 |
| `lon` | number | yes | min -180.0; max 180.0 |

### BaseStationState

The RTK base station of a mower as its connection sees it (`MowerState.base_station`).

Null on the mower state when the mower is linked to no base station in Fleet.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `base_station_id` | string (uuid) or null | no | Fleet's id of the base station (from the registration). |
| `correction_link` | [RtkCorrectionLink](#rtkcorrectionlink) | no | How the corrections reach the mower now; `network` means the mower does not use its base station at the moment.; default `"unknown"` |
| `details_at` | string (date-time) or null | no | When the details (`satellites`, `rtk_status`, `wifi_dbm`) were last reported; null when never. |
| `firmware` | string or null | no | The base station's firmware, as reported. |
| `firmware_info` | [FirmwareInfo](#firmwareinfo) or null | no | Installed and offered firmware of the base station from the vendor's firmware service, and the update state; null before a check. |

### GeoReference

Anchors the local frame on the earth.

The local point `(0, 0)` is at `(origin_lat, origin_lon)`. The local axes are the east and north axes rotated counter-clockwise by `rotation_deg`: a local point `(x, y)` lies `east = x cos(r) - y sin(r)` and `north = x sin(r) + y cos(r)` metres from the origin.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `origin_lat` | number | yes | min -90.0; max 90.0 |
| `origin_lon` | number | yes | min -180.0; max 180.0 |
| `rotation_deg` | number | no | min -360.0; max 360.0; default `0.0` |

### MowerCapabilities

Feature flags and limits of one mower behind one connection.

All fields default to "not supported", so an adapter only declares what it really offers.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `base_station_firmware_update` | boolean | no | The connection can ask the manufacturer's firmware service for the linked RTK base station and install its updates (`firmware_check` with target `base_station`, `base_station_firmware_update`; ADR 0047).; default `false` |
| `blade_height_range_mm` | array of any or null | no | Inclusive (min, max) blade height in millimetres, if settable. |
| `camera` | [CameraAccess](#cameraaccess) | no | default `"none"` |
| `connection_kinds` | array of [ConnectionKind](#connectionkind) | no | Connection kinds this mower can use. |
| `custom_paths` | boolean | no | The mower can follow an arbitrary path or boundary (False for LUBA today).; default `false` |
| `cutting_width_mm` | integer or null | no | Width of the cut swath in millimetres, if known (coverage heatmaps). |
| `drive_reverse` | boolean | no | The drive link that carries the joystick frames can drive backwards (a negative `ManualDrive.linear`). Without it the web joystick offers no reverse and a spot run's `multi_point` turns fall back to `arc` (ADR 0043).; default `false` |
| `drive_speed_setting` | [DriveSpeedSetting](#drivespeedsetting) or null | no | The vendor's speed setting for manual driving can be read (`MowerState.drive_speed_mps`) and changed (`set_drive_speed`) within this range; null when the connection cannot (ADR 0042). |
| `firmware_update` | boolean | no | The connection can ask the manufacturer's firmware service for updates and install them (`firmware_check`, `firmware_update`).; default `false` |
| `light` | boolean | no | The mower's light (the camera's headlamp on Mammotion mowers) can be switched with `set_light`.; default `false` |
| `links_supported` | array of string | no | Additional link kinds this connection can open next to its primary one (e.g. `ble_bridge`); empty when the mower has only its primary connection.; max items 8 |
| `maintenance` | array of `"restart_mower"` \| `"sync_map"` \| `"relocate_dock"` \| `"leave_dock"` \| `"resync_rtk"` | no | Maintenance commands this connection can send (ADR 0048): `restart_mower`, `sync_map`, `relocate_dock`, `leave_dock` (only together with `undock`), `resync_rtk`. Clients offer only these; empty when the connection has none. |
| `manual_drive` | boolean | no | Joystick driving is supported.; default `false` |
| `manual_drive_blades` | boolean | no | Blades may run during manual driving when a frame explicitly asks for it.; default `false` |
| `max_speed_mps` | number or null | no | Highest settable driving speed while mowing. |
| `min_speed_mps` | number or null | no | Lowest settable driving speed while mowing, if the model has one. |
| `model` | string or null | no | Mower model, if known. |
| `native_patterns` | array of string | no | Mowing pattern names the mower runs natively on its own map areas, for example `stripes`, `diagonal`, `checkerboard`, `edge_only`. |
| `path_spacing_range_mm` | array of any or null | no | Inclusive (min, max) distance between neighbouring mowing paths in millimetres (`MowPattern.spacing_m`), if the model has a settable spacing. |
| `rtk_sources` | array of [RtkSource](#rtksource) | no | RTK correction sources the mower can report. |
| `settings` | array of [SettingSpec](#settingspec) | no | The mower's own settings this connection can read and change with `set_setting` (ADR 0046), each with its type and range or options; current values in `MowerState.settings`. Empty when the connection offers none.; max items 32 |
| `start_options` | [StartOptions](#startoptions) | no | Job options a native start may carry besides the pattern (obstacle detection, laps around no-go zones, path order, start progress; ADR 0030). Clients show only what is declared here. |
| `undock` | boolean | no | The connection can make the mower leave its charging station by itself (`leave_dock`), so a spot run may start from the dock (ADR 0041).; default `false` |

### MowerState

A telemetry snapshot of one mower, published on `telemetry.mower.<id>`.

Two times: `observed_at` is when the mower reported the values, `heartbeat_at` when the gateway's link to it was last alive. A docked mower reports rarely, so old values do not mean an offline mower (ADR 0040).

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `activity` | [MowerActivity](#moweractivity) | yes |  |
| `base_station` | [BaseStationState](#basestationstate) or null | no | The RTK base station the mower is linked to in Fleet, as the mower's connection sees it (correction link, satellites, position, firmware; ADR 0047); null for a mower without a linked base station. |
| `battery_percent` | integer | yes | min 0.0; max 100.0 |
| `blade_height_mm` | integer or null | no |  |
| `charging` | boolean | no | default `false` |
| `connected` | boolean | no | False in the state the Device-Gateway publishes right after its connection to the mower ended: the last known values, with `heartbeat_at` the last time the link was alive. Set by the gateway, never by an adapter.; default `true` |
| `connection` | [ConnectionKind](#connectionkind) | yes |  |
| `drive_calibration` | [DriveCalibrationStatus](#drivecalibrationstatus) or null | no | The drive calibration MowDeck runs on this mower (`DriveCalibrate`, ADR 0042), with its final state and result kept until the next one; null when there never was one. |
| `drive_recoverable` | boolean | no | With activity `error`: the error is not a safety sensor stop, so manual driving may free the mower (stuck, wheel slip). Lift, tilt and collision stops are never drive recoverable; the controller refuses drive frames for them.; default `false` |
| `drive_speed_mps` | number or null | no | The vendor's speed setting for manual driving (`MowerCapabilities.drive_speed_setting`); null when the connection has none or has not read it yet. |
| `error_category` | [MowerErrorCategory](#mowererrorcategory) or null | no | With activity `error`: the manufacturer-neutral kind of the fault; null otherwise or when the connection cannot tell. |
| `error_code` | string or null | no |  |
| `error_message` | string or null | no |  |
| `firmware` | string or null | no |  |
| `firmware_info` | [FirmwareInfo](#firmwareinfo) or null | no | Installed and available firmware and the update state; null when the adapter has not checked (or cannot check) the vendor. |
| `gnss` | [GnssStatus](#gnssstatus) or null | no | Satellite positioning details (satellites, RTK correction age, solution); null when the connection does not report them. |
| `heartbeat_at` | string (date-time) or null | no | When the Device-Gateway last knew its connection to the mower alive (UTC). The gateway sets it on every publish, never an adapter: it advances with each heartbeat while `observed_at` stays the time of the mower's last report. Clients judge online and offline by it (ADR 0040); null in states from before the field, then `observed_at` stands in. |
| `job` | [JobProgress](#jobprogress) or null | no | The mowing job the mower runs (progress, current area, elapsed and remaining seconds, mowed square metres); null when none runs or the connection does not report it. |
| `light_on` | boolean or null | no | Whether the mower's light (the camera's headlamp) is on, as the mower reports it; null when not reported (no light, or no answer yet). |
| `links` | map of [LinkStatus](#linkstatus) | no | State of the mower's additional links by kind (e.g. `ble_bridge`); empty for a mower with only its primary connection. |
| `mower_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `observed_at` | string (date-time) | yes | When the device reported this state (UTC). |
| `position` | [GeoPosition](#geoposition) or null | no |  |
| `position_source` | [PositionSource](#positionsource) | no | Where `position` comes from; `unknown` whenever `position` is null.; default `"unknown"` |
| `rain_detected` | boolean or null | no | The mower's own rain sensor reports rain right now; null when the connection does not report the sensor (ADR 0046). |
| `raw` | object | no | Adapter specific extras. Consumers must not rely on its structure; the typed fields above replace the keys they cover. |
| `rtk_fix` | [RtkFixStatus](#rtkfixstatus) | no | default `"unknown"` |
| `rtk_source` | [RtkSource](#rtksource) | no | default `"unknown"` |
| `self_check` | [SelfCheck](#selfcheck) or null | no | The mower's start self-check (`ok` or `blocked` with the reason); null when the connection does not report it. |
| `settings` | object | no | Current values of the mower's own settings (ADR 0046) by key, as the mower reported them; a declared setting the mower has not reported yet is missing. Types, ranges and options: `MowerCapabilities.settings`. |
| `signal` | [SignalStatus](#signalstatus) or null | no | The mower's own Wi-Fi and mobile signal in dBm and its uplink; null when the connection does not report them. |
| `speed_mps` | number or null | no |  |
| `spot_run` | [SpotRunStatus](#spotrunstatus) or null | no | The spot run MowDeck drives on this mower right now (`SpotMow`), with its final state kept until the next run; null when there never was one. |
| `turn_style` | [TurnStyle](#turnstyle) or null | no | How the mower turns at lane ends in its own jobs, as its connection reports the vendor setting (read only; ADR 0043). A spot run without its own `turn_style` uses it; null when the connection does not report one. |

### ObstacleDetection

How eagerly the mower avoids obstacles during a native job (`MowPattern`).

Which modes a mower offers depends on its model and firmware (`MowerCapabilities.start_options.obstacle_detection`). The names follow the vendor apps: `off` is the plain bump-and-turn behaviour, `standard` avoids obstacles it sees ahead, `sensitive` additionally avoids areas that are not lawn; `slow_touch` and `less_touch` exist only on older firmware.

Type: `"off"` \| `"slow_touch"` \| `"less_touch"` \| `"standard"` \| `"sensitive"`

### PathOrder

Whether the border laps run before or after the fill of a native job.

Type: `"border_first"` \| `"grid_first"`

`rtk` is the mower's own positioning with an RTK fix (fixed or float), `gnss` the same positioning without an RTK fix (single point, metres of scatter), `dock` the known pose of the charging station while the mower stands in it (the adapter reports the dock instead of the scattering raw position), `unknown` when there is no position or its quality is not known.

### TurnStyle

How a spot run turns at the end of a lane (ADR 0043).

`in_place`: the mower rotates on the spot (fast, but an all-wheel-drive mower scuffs the turf). `arc`: a forward U-turn with a radius of at least half the lane spacing, or a bulb turn over the neighbouring lane when the spacing is narrower than the turning radius. `multi_point`: a three-point turn (forward arc, reverse arc with the blades off, forward arc); needs a drive link that can reverse (`MowerCapabilities.drive_reverse`).

Type: `"in_place"` \| `"arc"` \| `"multi_point"`
